title: Why Transformers Replaced RNNs — Shorter Paths Improve Credit Assignment
key_insight: Self-attention creates a short connection between distant positions, which can make learning long-range relationships easier. Multiple heads provide several learned relationship maps.
body:
## Shorter Paths Improve Credit Assignment

A correction for one token must influence a far earlier token. In a recurrent chain, that path crosses every intermediate step.

Self-attention creates a short connection between distant positions, which can make learning long-range relationships easier. Multiple heads provide several learned relationship maps.

Transformers also rely on residual connections, normalization, and feed-forward layers; attention alone is not the entire architecture. Phase 6 assembles these pieces and explains their cost.
common_mistakes: Transformers read only the immediately previous token.
Parallel training means token order no longer matters.
Attention has zero memory cost at every sequence length.
